title: Four Nearest Neighbors
statement:
Implement monotonic-stack preprocessing to answer four types of nearest-neighbor query. Return the nearest index with a strictly greater or smaller value in the requested direction. Equal values never qualify.

Input
The first line contains n and q, followed by the n array values. Each query is type i. Types 1, 2, 3 and 4 mean next greater, next smaller, previous greater and previous smaller, respectively. Next means strictly to the right, previous strictly to the left.

Output
For each query print the 1-based index, or 0 if absent.

Constraints
1 ≤ n,q ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ i ≤ n, and each value has absolute value at most 10⁹. Aim for O(n) preprocessing and O(1) per query.
